title: I made a game where drunk grandpas steal wheelchairs and race each other down a mountain. You bet on who wins.
author: Jealous_Fan4986
selftext:
Hey! Solo dev here. I've been working on this for a while and it's finally coming out on Nov 5, so I wanted to share it.



It's called AfterPub. The idea is simple: it's closing time, the grandpas are drunk, and they steal every wheelchair and mobility scooter they can find to race down a mountain. You can race yourself, or just bet on the chaos.



What's in it:

\- Races with up to 12 grandpas, with items like banana peels, frying pans, olive oil and pigeons

\- 13 maps, from snowy peaks to a jungle and a neon city

\- A pub full of party games you can play with friends: poker, beer pong, bowling, hot potato with actual dynamite, beer roulette and more (20+ total)

\- 1v1 duels, tournaments, and side bets on literally everything

\- Tons of silly outfits and chair paints, all earned by playing (no microtransactions)

\- Online with friends over Steam, full controller support, and it runs on Steam Deck



It's best with a group of friends on a Friday night. Or a Tuesday, I'm not judging.



If it made you smile, a wishlist would honestly mean a lot. As a solo dev it's the biggest thing that helps the game get seen on Steam 🙏



[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371870/Afterpub/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371870/Afterpub/)
